description_en: Updates the basic information and common settings of a code repository
description_zh: 更新代码库基本信息、常用设置
name: UpdateRepository

parameters.help_en: The enterprise ID. This parameter is a string and can be obtained from the Yunxiao URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[OrganizationId]
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS) for temporary authorization
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。 
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the code repository
parameters.help_zh: 代码库ID
parameters.name: repository_id

parameters.help_en: The primary programming language of the repository. Administrator permissions are required
parameters.help_zh: 仓库主要编程语言（需管理员权限）
parameters.name: admin_setting_language

parameters.help_en: The URL of the avatar
parameters.help_zh: 头像地址
parameters.name: avatar

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable builds. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启构建
可选值：true / false
parameters.name: builds_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to check email addresses. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否检查邮箱
可选值：true / false
parameters.name: check_email

parameters.help_en: The default branch
parameters.help_zh: 默认分支
parameters.name: default_branch

parameters.help_en: The description of the code repository
parameters.help_zh: 代码库描述
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the code repository
parameters.help_zh: 代码库ID
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable issues. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启issues
可选值：true / false
parameters.name: issues_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable merge requests. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启代码合并
可选值：true / false
parameters.name: merge_requests_enabled

parameters.help_en: The name of the code repository
parameters.help_zh: 代码库名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable clone and download control. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启克隆下载控制
可选值：true / false
parameters.name: open_clone_download_control

parameters.help_en: The path of the code repository
parameters.help_zh: 代码库路径
parameters.name: path

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the role is allowed. Valid values:
true: Allowed.
false: Not allowed
fields.help_zh:
是否允许
可选值：true / false
fields.name: allowed

fields.help_en:
The permission code for cloning and downloading. Valid values:
`project:ssh-clone`: Allows SSH cloning.
`project:http-clone`: Allows HTTP cloning.
`project:download`: Allows downloading
fields.help_zh:
clone下载权限码
`project:ssh-clone` ：允许ssh clone
`project:http-clone`：允许http clone
`project:download`：允许下载
fields.name: permission_code

parameters.help_en: The list of methods that are allowed to pull code
parameters.help_zh: 被允许的拉取代码方法列表
parameters.name: project_clone_download_method_list

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the role is allowed. Valid values:
true: Allowed.
false: Not allowed
fields.help_zh:
是否允许
可选值：true / false
fields.name: allowed

fields.help_en:
The role code. Valid values:
15: Workspace member.
60: Storage management administrator.
70: Workspace owner
fields.help_zh:
角色代码
15：空间成员
60：空间管理员
70：空间拥有者
fields.name: role_code

parameters.help_en: The list of roles that are allowed to pull code
parameters.help_zh: 被允许的拉取代码角色列表
parameters.name: project_clone_download_role_list

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable snippets
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启snippets
parameters.name: snippets_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The visibility level of the code repository. Valid values:
0: Private. The repository is visible only to its members.
10: Internal. The repository is visible to all members of the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
代码仓库可见性
0：私有，仅代码库成员可见
10：企业内公开，企业成员可见
parameters.name: visibility_level

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the wiki. Valid values:
true: Enabled.

是否开启wiki
可选值：true / false
